download.title: Download mode
download.concurrentHint: How many built-in browser downloads may run at once (1–10). Extra tasks queue up and start automatically when a slot frees. Applies to the built-in browser channel only: aria2 / iwaradl control their own concurrency
download.linkCheck: Check for third-party file host links
download.linkCheckHint: Before downloading, scans the video description and comments. On a match it does not download; it leaves a to-do in the task list instead (open the video page or force the download). Video detail pages are skipped: you are already looking at the description and comments
download.modeOthersLabel: Others (open direct link in a background tab)
download.modeOthersHint: The browser handles the download; universal fallback
download.modeBrowserHint: Built-in download (default); creates subdirectories from the path template
download.modeAria2Hint: Local or remote aria2; live tracking over WebSocket
download.copySaveName: Copy file name when a download link is found
download.copySaveNameHint: When a third-party file host link appears in the description or comments, copy the computed file name to the clipboard (same behaviour as the userscript).
download.pathNote: Directory separators: / and \. Verify variables with the preview below.
download.sampleTitle: Sample video title (long titles are truncated when enabled)
download.socialNote: Runs after a successful parse, in parallel with the download; failures never block it.
download.autoFollowHint: Calls the iwara API only when not already following
download.autoLikeHint: Calls the iwara API only when not already liked
download.priorityNote: Higher wins. With "Pick by priority" enabled only the chosen quality is used; falls back to the first source.

rpc.checkNote: Verifies the path template can be resolved and probes the endpoint for the current download channel. Runs once when this tab opens.
rpc.aria2Note: Completion and failure events arrive over WebSocket; falls back to HTTP polling when disconnected.
rpc.aria2PathHint: http(s):// form; the WS address is derived from it
rpc.aria2TokenPlaceholder: Leave empty if the local instance has no secret
rpc.iwaradlNote: HTTP API channel; task state is reconciled by the background scan/retry
rpc.statsNote: Real occupancy read from the aria2 RPC / iwaradl API. Each backend has its own concurrency limit (aria2's max-concurrent-downloads), and their queues may contain tasks this extension did not submit — so the number downloading at once can exceed your "simultaneous downloads" setting
rpc.statsNotAria2: The response is not aria2's format (check the RPC address)
rpc.proxyNote: Forwarded to both aria2 (all-proxy) and iwaradl (proxy_url)

filter.title: List filtering and backfill
filter.note: Rewrites the /videos response on iwara pages; applies without a reload
filter.likedHint: Videos you already liked no longer appear in lists
filter.unlistedFilter: Hide unlisted/private videos on the subscription feed
filter.unlistedFilterHint: Only affects /videos?subscribed=true; mutually exclusive with the backfill below
filter.unlistedAddHint: Merges cached unlisted/private videos into the timeline by time window (page window ±4h); mutually exclusive with the previous option

clean.title: File name cleaning rules
clean.note: Applied top to bottom to the TITLE / ALIAS variables
clean.foldHint: é→e and similar decomposed residue folds to _

tasks.title: Download queue
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Right-click a video link on an iwara page → "Iwara Assistant → Download this video", or batch download from the in-page menu.
tasks.attentionBanner: {n} task(s) need your attention: failed ones can be retried; those with a third-party download link should be opened in the video page so you can choose how to download (or force the download).
tasks.emptyFiltered: No tasks match the current filter.
tasks.footer: The queue is persisted by the background and survives extension suspension or a browser restart. Actions here are executed by the background; a running task must finish before it can be removed. Skipped tasks never count towards the badge and are not removed by "Clear finished".
tasks.notInQueue: {id} is no longer in the queue
tasks.skippedDetail: Description or comments contain a third-party file host link, so the download was skipped
tasks.waitingSlot: Waiting for a free slot (simultaneous download limit {n})
tasks.skippedHint: Open the video page to read the description and comments, or force the download
tasks.runningCancelHint: The download is cancelled first, then the task is removed (cannot be undone)
tasks.cancelStillRunning: Cancel failed: the download is still running (the downloader did not respond); the task was kept
tasks.removedUntracked: Removed the record for {id}; this backend cannot be cancelled, so it may still be downloading
tasks.adoptedByBrowser: The browser is downloading it now (progress is tracked)
tasks.iwaradlMissing: iwaradl no longer has this task (it was deleted, or the daemon lost its list after a restart)
tasks.iwaradlFailed: iwaradl reported the download as failed
tasks.iwaradlUnreachable: Could not reach iwaradl several times in a row, so the result is unknown
tasks.handedOffOthers: Handed to an external downloader (direct link opened in a background tab); the extension cannot see the result
tasks.handedOffIwaradl: Submitted to iwaradl; check iwaradl for progress
tasks.staleInterrupted: Download was interrupted (state found after the extension restarted)
tasks.staleMissing: This download is gone from the browser (cancelled or deleted)
tasks.staleAria2: aria2 is not configured, so this task can no longer be tracked
tasks.staleNeverDelivered: The extension restarted while dispatching; delivery could not be confirmed

friends.title: One-click approval
friends.note: Fetches all incoming friend requests and approves the ones matching the conditions below (requests are throttled to 300ms).
friends.modeHint: any = approve when any condition matches; all = every condition must match
friends.evidenceHint: Only used by "commented in the given forum thread"; accepts the last URL segment or the raw ID
friends.evidencePlaceholder: Empty means that condition never matches
friends.conditionsNote: Check the conditions that participate; "Approve unconditionally" should only be used for testing
friends.needCondition: No condition selected: nothing will be approved. Pick at least one (or "Approve unconditionally")
friends.aborted: The last run was interrupted (background context reclaimed or extension reloaded) and its outcome is unknown. Just run it again — already-approved requests will not be handled twice
friends.collecting: Fetching the request list and comment evidence…

condition.commentedForumThread: Commented in the given forum thread

migrate.legacyTitle: Import from the old userscript database
migrate.legacyNote: The userscript stored videos, follows, friends and the ID map in the iwara.tv page. Detect it here and pull everything with one click; records are merged by ID and nothing is deleted.
migrate.legacyNeverScanned: Not scanned yet: opening (or refreshing) any iwara.tv page after installing detects it automatically.
migrate.legacyFound: Old userscript database found: videos {videos} / follows {follows} / friends {friends} / map {idmap} (scanned {scanned})
migrate.legacyNotFound: No old userscript database (IwaraDownloadTool) found on iwara.tv.
migrate.importStart: Read and import the old database
migrate.legacyFootnote: An open iwara.tv tab is required: only scripts on that origin can read the page database. It only holds library data — the userscript configuration lives in the userscript manager's private storage, which the page cannot read, so paste its "export configuration" text below. Importing again writes the old records back (deleted items reappear); use it only for a fresh migration.
migrate.unreadable: {n} records could not be read (corrupted or oversized)
migrate.exportNote: Config / video library / follows / friends / ID map. The result can be imported again (paste or file) for backup or moving to another machine.
migrate.exportHint: The userscript's "export configuration" also copies the config text to the clipboard (without the four library tables) — paste it below to migrate it.
migrate.exported: Exported: {videos} videos / {follows} follows / {friends} friends / {idmap} map entries
migrate.copied: Copied the full migration package: {videos} videos / {follows} follows / {friends} friends / {idmap} map entries
migrate.copyFailed: Copy failed: {message}; use "Export as JSON file" instead
migrate.clipboardTooLarge: Too large for the clipboard ({limit} characters). Use "Export as JSON file" instead.
migrate.importNote: Two accepted formats: the clipboard text from the userscript's "export configuration" (config only), or this extension's "export all data" package (including the four library tables). Pasting and choosing a file are equivalent.
migrate.configRejected: ⚠ {n} config keys had invalid values and were skipped: {keys} (the rest were saved)
migrate.configIgnored: ⚠ {n} config keys are not supported by this extension and were ignored: {keys}
migrate.storeFailed: ⚠ {store}: {n} records failed to write (too large or invalid data) and were skipped
migrate.kindConfig: a config file (clipboard JSON from the userscript's "export configuration")

advanced.pageNote: Only affects iwara pages (content script and declarative styles)
advanced.beautifyHint: Rounded cards, unified borders, consistent hover feedback
advanced.widescreenHint: Widens the page container so more cards fit per row
advanced.injectCheckboxHint: List pages start in selection mode; when disabled you can still enable it from the in-page menu
advanced.autoCollapseHint: The floating menu collapses when the pointer leaves or you click outside
advanced.syncNote: Walks the iwara lists page by page and writes them to the local library; you may leave this page
advanced.behaviorNote: Background behaviour of the extension itself, unrelated to iwara pages
advanced.promoteHint: On by default: follows the author and adds them as a friend on first start, then never repeats (retries on the next start when signed out)
advanced.keepAliveHint: Chrome only (off by default): an offscreen document wakes the background every 20 seconds so aria2 WebSocket notifications stay real-time. Completion notices no longer wait for the 5-minute fallback scan, at the cost of the background no longer being reclaimed when idle (the browser doesn't actually guarantee it works). Firefox's background page is already persistent, so this is unnecessary there.
advanced.experimentalNote: Experimental capabilities such as MediaCenter integration must be enabled here first
advanced.experimentalEnableHint: MediaCenter configuration and push only appear when enabled
advanced.unsafeHint: Removes the 1 second gap between queued downloads; too fast may trigger iwara rate limiting
advanced.debugHint: Shows a debug marker in the in-page watermark (clicking the watermark 5 times also enables it)
advanced.linkNote: Sends a HEAD request from the background (bypassing page CORS) to verify a direct link or RPC endpoint
advanced.mediaNote: Pushes metadata automatically after a download; requires a server API key

guide.quickNote: Three steps to your first download
guide.step1: Choose a download method on the Download tab. For Aria2 / iwaradl, just fill in the endpoint address on the RPC tab — all-site access is granted at install, so there is no per-endpoint authorization step.
guide.step2Before: On iwara.tv, right-click a video link →
guide.step2After: → Download this video; you can also batch download from the in-page floating menu.
guide.step3: Track progress on the Queue tab (system notifications also report completion and failures). Users coming from the userscript should first import old data on the Migrate tab.
guide.accessNote: Declared once in the extension manifest — no per-site authorization prompt
guide.accessHint: Set site access back to "On all sites" on the browser's extension management page, then reload.
guide.accessWhy: Why all sites: the external endpoints (aria2 / iwaradl / MediaCenter) are arbitrary addresses you type, and phishing protection has to inspect the host name of any site you open — neither can be enumerated in advance.
guide.phishingNote: Runs on every page; official Iwara sites are untouched
guide.phishingRule: If the host name is not an official domain but contains "iwara", the page is treated as a suspected impersonation site.
guide.phishingBlock: While the warning is shown, the browser blocks every request the page makes — images, fonts, cross-origin frames, form posts and beacons alike. Only navigating away still works.
guide.storageValue: Everything stays in this browser: config and queue in storage.local, the video library in the extension's own IndexedDB
guide.privacyValue: No data is collected or uploaded; no developer server, no telemetry. Refresh tokens are stored in the page exactly like the original userscript.

v0113.item1: Batch download now de-duplicates: re-selecting videos that are already downloaded or downloading no longer creates duplicate tasks (a zero-cost local queue check, plus a skip when aria2 already has the same video). Previously this piled up duplicate 0% tasks in aria2
v0113.item2: De-duplication no longer depends on the "experimental features" switch: it is a safety net against duplicate submission, while that switch is documented as controlling MediaCenter only. Videos that previously failed are still retried (re-selecting them means trying again)
v0113.item3: Moved "Check for third-party file host links" from the Filter tab to the Download tab: it really does block a download (leaving a to-do), so it is download behavior rather than list rewriting. The label and hint now say "description and comments" instead of comments only
v0113.item4: The task queue can now track all four download backends: iwaradl is polled through its task API (every minute, only while there is work), and others tasks are adopted once the browser actually starts downloading. iwaradl can be cancelled too (queued tasks only). Also fixed a real bug: the iwaradl task key was read from the wrong field, so it could never be tracked
v0113.item5: Built-in download on Firefox no longer flattens subdirectories into underscores: the path template now produces the exact same folder structure on both browsers (the 2016 Firefox bug this was based on had already been fixed in version 51)
v0113.item6: The default download method for new installs is now "built-in browser download": it is the only method that reports real progress/completion/failure back to the queue while depending on no external service. The previous default (Others) only opened a direct-link tab and went silent once the task was handed off
v0113.item7: New setting "Simultaneous downloads": how many built-in browser downloads may run at once (default 3). Selecting a batch of videos used to start them all at once, which meant dozens of parallel connections to the site; now the extra ones queue up and start as earlier downloads finish
v0113.item8: The task list now shows the real progress reported by aria2 / iwaradl, and the RPC tab has a new "Backend capacity" panel (aria2: downloading / queued / speed / concurrency limit; iwaradl: downloading / queued counts). Also fixed a dishonest label: tasks sitting in aria2's own queue used to read "Downloading" and now read "Queued"

v0112.item1: The in-page "Download selected" item no longer appends a selected count: the count is shown only in the bottom-right watermark (matching the original userscript — the same state was being displayed twice)
v0112.item2: Removed the in-page "Remove selected from playlist" item: playlist entries are removed with the per-card "Delete" button, which is the original userscript's only entry point
v0112.item3: System notifications are now clickable: a task notification opens the task panel, a third-party link notification opens that video page, an approval notification opens the friends page, and a playlist-removal notification opens that playlist

v0111.item1: Friend-request approval now has a progress bar: indeterminate while fetching requests and comment evidence, then "processed / total" plus approved·skipped·failed counters while working through the list
v0111.item2: Approval state is persisted: leaving the page and coming back still shows "Approving…" with live progress, so it is no longer mistaken for idle and triggered twice
v0111.item3: A second concurrent run is rejected by the background with "Approval is already running"; progress writes are throttled to 200 ms instead of one write per request
v0111.item4: After a batch download creates its tasks, the in-page checkboxes are cleared as each item is processed (matching the original userscript; items skipped by aria2 de-duplication are cleared too)

v0110.item1: Fixed friend-approval condition labels: "active within {days} days" / "account older than {days} days" no longer render the literal placeholder, and the numbers share the same constants as the checks
v0110.item2: Fixed friend-request pagination: no longer burns through all 32 pages when the server omits `limit`, and reports honestly when the page cap means only part of the list was processed
v0110.item3: Approval conditions now default to none selected (no longer "approve unconditionally"): with nothing checked the run button is disabled and the reason is shown under the list

v019.item1: Firefox build now uses MV2: LAN / private-network endpoints over plain http / ws (e.g. aria2 on a NAS) connect directly — no HTTPS reverse proxy and no need to colocate the service
v019.item2: New "Keep background alive" switch (Chrome only, off by default): with it on, completion notices ride the aria2 WebSocket instead of waiting for the 5-minute fallback scan
v019.item3: Removed the never-effective "Enable one-click approval" switch from the friends tab: approval has always been an explicit action on that page, and the condition list plus any / all mode are unchanged

v018.item1: Phishing protection upgraded to network-level blocking: while the warning is shown, every request the page makes (images, fonts, form posts, beacons, cross-origin frames) is blocked by the browser — page scripts cannot lift it
v018.item2: Only a real click in the warning panel releases the block; the rule is cleaned up when you leave the site, close the tab, or exit the browser

v016.item1: Migration tab handles gigabyte-scale libraries: streaming export/import with live export progress
v016.item2: New phishing-site protection: warns and blocks network access when a non-official host name contains "iwara"
v016.item3: External endpoints (aria2 / iwaradl / MediaCenter) now report an actionable reason and the setting to fix, instead of a raw browser error
v016.item4: Simpler permission model: all-site access is granted once at install, no per-endpoint prompts

v010.item1: Four download channels: Browser / Aria2 / iwaradl / Others
v010.item2: Filterable task queue with per-task retry/remove, retry-all-failed and clear-finished
v010.item3: Live preview of the download path template plus file name cleaning (NFKC / emoji / illegal characters / truncation)
v010.item4: iwara list filtering, unlisted/private cache backfill, card checkboxes and floating menu
v010.item5: Automatic video library ingest; cards show followed/downloaded badges and upload time
v010.item6: One-click friend request approval with combinable conditions
v010.item7: Migration wizard for userscript data (config / video library / follows / friends / ID map)
v010.item8: aria2 WebSocket live tracking with alarms-based reconciliation and automatic retry
v010.item9: Interface available in 简体中文 / English / 日本語, following the browser language by default

error.jsonObject: Expected a JSON object (the top level cannot be an array, string or number)
error.configNotObject: The config field must be an object
error.noImportable: The migration package has nothing to import (config is empty and all four tables are missing)
error.unrecognized: Unrecognized JSON: neither a full migration package (config / videos / follows / friends / idmap) nor any known configuration key
error.emptyInput: The pasted content or file is empty
error.endpointInvalid: Invalid {target} endpoint: {endpoint} (a full http/https URL is required)
error.endpointNotAuthorized: Not authorized to reach the {target} endpoint {host}: set Site access to “On all sites” on the extension's details page, then retry (the endpoint address lives under {settingsPath})
error.endpointRejected: The {target} endpoint is reachable but the server rejected the request: {detail}
error.hintDaemon: (is the daemon running? is the port correct?)
error.hintService: (is the service online? is the host/port reachable?)
error.endpointBlocked: {host} is outside the sites this extension is allowed to reach, so the browser rejected the request: {detail} (a permission limit, not a network failure — widen Site access on the extension's details page)
error.endpointLanBlocked: Cannot reach the {target} endpoint {host}: {detail} (Firefox's local network access policy blocks http requests from extensions to LAN addresses — this is not a permission problem; use an aria2 on 127.0.0.1, or put the endpoint behind an https reverse proxy)
